title: Paper Plane
description: Item-driven FTB Essentials teleport requests from craftable paper planes.
body:
# Paper Plane

**Send FTB Essentials teleport requests from a small craftable paper plane.**

Paper Plane adds an item-driven player picker for `/tpa` without replacing FTB Essentials' own teleport flow. The sender chooses an online player from an FTB Library screen; FTB Essentials creates the actual request and shows its normal clickable accept/deny chat prompt to the target player.

![Choose a player with the Paper Plane UI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Ead9jIT4/images/ba4bada3211219cb16eaf0fb6c1d2433b181f746_350.webp)

## What it does

- Adds **Paper Plane**, **Paper Plane That Can't Fly?**, and **Ender Paper Plane** items.
- Right-click opens a simple FTB Library player picker.
- The selected target receives FTB Essentials' standard TPA request message.
- Shift-right-click throws the paper plane as a slow arrow-like projectile.
- Drop a Paper Plane into water to turn it into **Paper Plane That Can't Fly?** through a Lychee item-inside-liquid recipe.

![Lychee water recipe in JEI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Ead9jIT4/images/3b3c34a32702ccf76a5a359ee96bf634d24007ad_350.webp)
- Ender Paper Plane can send requests without consuming the item.

![Paper Plane items in a Minecraft inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Ead9jIT4/images/6d985b40655e5dab6f9494b1323bcc55471a694a_350.webp)

## Paper Plane recipe

Craft a Paper Plane from five pieces of paper.

![Paper Plane JEI recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Ead9jIT4/images/09508b93a61ec294579aede795214711fd594dc1_350.webp)

Normal paper planes and Paper Plane That Can't Fly? are consumed after the target accepts the FTB Essentials TPA request. FTB Essentials owns the accept, deny, warmup, cooldown, and final teleport behavior.

![Paper Plane in hand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Ead9jIT4/images/1a72ef13ddb4dece591c83995a63e0f8e135b9ae_350.webp)

## Ender Paper Plane recipe

Craft an Ender Paper Plane with eight ender pearls around one Paper Plane.

![Ender Paper Plane JEI recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Ead9jIT4/images/88434938a6cfdf7d5d77494a40d3897c614a48a3_350.webp)

The Ender Paper Plane is reusable, so it can send FTB Essentials TPA requests without being consumed.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge
- FTB Essentials
- FTB Library
- Architectury API
- Lychee
- Kiwi

FTB Essentials, FTB Library, and Lychee are required on both client and server. Architectury API is required by FTB Library; Kiwi is required by Lychee. JEI is not required; it is used only for the recipe screenshots on this page.
